headline: Nigerian Naira Faces Pressure as Parallel-Official FX Spread Widens
summary: Nigeria's parallel market exchange rate experienced heightened dollar demand from festive imports and early preparations for the 2027 general elections. The divergence with the official window widened despite central bank dollar liquidity interventions.
why: The Central Bank of Nigeria has implemented FX reforms to unify currency windows and curb parallel market premiums, a key consideration for international investors in Nigerian sovereign debt.

impacts.name: Nigerian Naira
impacts.why: Surging domestic seasonal demand and election spending widened the spread in the informal FX market.
